ai_analysis_runs_success_chk.name: ai_analysis_runs_success_chk
ai_analysis_runs_success_chk.value: "ai_analysis_runs"."status" <> 'succeeded' or ("ai_analysis_runs"."model_name" is not null and "ai_analysis_runs"."model_version" is not null and "ai_analysis_runs"."result_file_id" is not null and "ai_analysis_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

ai_analysis_runs_failure_chk.name: ai_analysis_runs_failure_chk
ai_analysis_runs_failure_chk.value: "ai_analysis_runs"."status" <> 'failed' or ("ai_analysis_runs"."failure_code" is not null and "ai_analysis_runs"."completed_at" is not null)

anesthesia_assessments_approval_chk.name: anesthesia_assessments_approval_chk
anesthesia_assessments_approval_chk.value: "anesthesia_assessments"."approval_state" <> 'approved' or ("anesthesia_assessments"."approved_by_provider_id" is not null and "anesthesia_assessments"."approved_at" is not null and "anesthesia_assessments"."modeled_output" is not null)

appointments_cancellation_chk.name: appointments_cancellation_chk
appointments_cancellation_chk.value: ("appointments"."status" not in ('cancelled', 'no_show')) or "appointments"."cancelled_at" is not null

billing_ledger_amount_chk.name: billing_ledger_amount_chk
billing_ledger_amount_chk.value: abs("billing_ledger"."amount_minor")<=1000000000000 and (("billing_ledger"."kind" in ('draft_created','draft_revised','draft_discarded') and "billing_ledger"."amount_minor"=0) or ("billing_ledger"."kind" in ('invoice_issued','refund') and "billing_ledger"."amount_minor">0) or ("billing_ledger"."kind"='payment' and "billing_ledger"."amount_minor"<0) or ("billing_ledger"."kind"='adjustment' and "billing_ledger"."amount_minor"<>0))

billing_ledger_sources_chk.name: billing_ledger_sources_chk
billing_ledger_sources_chk.value: ("billing_ledger"."kind"='payment' and "billing_ledger"."payment_id" is not null and "billing_ledger"."refund_id" is null and "billing_ledger"."receipt_reference" is not null) or ("billing_ledger"."kind"='refund' and "billing_ledger"."payment_id" is not null and "billing_ledger"."refund_id" is not null and "billing_ledger"."receipt_reference" is not null) or ("billing_ledger"."kind" not in ('payment','refund') and "billing_ledger"."payment_id" is null and "billing_ledger"."refund_id" is null and "billing_ledger"."receipt_reference" is null)

encounters_signature_chk.name: encounters_signature_chk
encounters_signature_chk.value: "encounters"."status" = 'open' or ("encounters"."signed_at" is not null and "encounters"."signed_by_membership_id" is not null)

schedule_blocks_resource_chk.name: schedule_blocks_resource_chk
schedule_blocks_resource_chk.value: "schedule_blocks"."operatory_id" is not null or "schedule_blocks"."provider_id" is not null
